description: Manual Federal Elections Analysis race calls. The live results API never makes calls for us. Edit this file, push it, and the site will show the call on the main results board and race detail page.

_howToUse.candidateNameRule: Candidate names must match the candidate name in the race JSON exactly. Use raceIdGuide below to find the race, then copy the candidate name from that race page if needed.

statusOptions.winner: Use for a final or certain single-winner call. Label shown: Winner.
statusOptions.projected: Use for a single-winner projection before the result is final. Label shown: Projected winner.
statusOptions.advances: Use for top-two/open-primary candidates who are projected to advance. Label shown: Advances.
statusOptions.advanced: Use when a top-two/open-primary advance is final. Label shown: Advanced to general election.

_howToUse.optionalLabel: You can add a custom label field to any call if you need exact wording, for example { "candidate": "Name", "status": "projected", "label": "Projected winner" }.
_howToUse.optionalCalledAt: You can add calledAt in ISO format, for example "2026-06-02T20:45:00-05:00". The OBS overlay uses this to decide which call is newest.
_howToUse.obsOverlay: For livestreams, add call-overlay.html as an OBS Browser Source. Suggested size: 1920x300, transparent background enabled. It checks this file automatically.
_howToUse.important: Do not put example calls inside the real races object unless you want them live on the site.
